attchmntText: Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Gayatri Highways Limited filed newspaper clippings of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 12th November 2026. Statutory auditors issued a qualified conclusion. The company defaulted on a term loan of Rs. 3,614.26 Lakhs payable to IL&FS Financial Services Limited. Auditors noted the company did not provide interest on this loan for the period 01 April 2026 to 30 September 2026. Had interest been provided, expenses would have increased and profit after tax would have reduced by Rs. 136.65 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 271.81 Lakhs for the half year. The company has not impaired investments in Cyberabad Expressways Limited and Hyderabad Expressways Limited. Auditors state profits are overstated due to these unprovided impairments. The holding company did not receive audited financial statements of Indore Dewas Tollways Limited, which is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

attchmntText: Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms Ms. Venkata Sindhuja Pothapragada as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gayatri Highways Limited has intimated the resignation of Ms. Venkata Sindhuja Pothapragada, Independent Director, with DIN 08852765. The resignation was tendered via letter dated 11th November 2026 and takes effect from 11th November 2026. The director confirmed there are no other material reasons for the resignation. She cited the company's renewed strategic outlook and evolving leadership vision as the basis for reassessing her professional commitments. The company has enclosed the resignation letter and required details under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The resignation is effective from the closing of business hours on 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms M/s. MOS & Associates LLP., Chartered Accountants  as Internal Auditor of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gayatri Highways Limited has notified the resignation of Ms. K. V. Meher Vani, Chartered Accountant, from the position of Internal Auditor, effective 11th November, 2026. The Board of Directors took note of this resignation due to pre-occupation and other professional commitments. Consequently, the Board approved the appointment of M/s MOS & Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants, as the new Internal Auditor. This appointment is effective from 12th November, 2026, to fill the vacancy for the Financial Year 2026-27. The firm is based in Hyderabad and has over three decades of professional experience. The company submitted this intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mrs K. V. Meher Vani, Chartered Accountant  as Internal Auditor of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gayatri Highways Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding changes to its Internal Auditor. The Board of Directors took note of the resignation of Ms. K. V. Meher Vani, Chartered Accountant, from the position of Internal Auditor with effect from 11th November, 2026. The resignation was due to pre-occupation and other professional commitments. On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Board approved the appointment of M/s MOS & Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants, as the new Internal Auditor. This appointment is effective from 12th November, 2026, to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation. The term of appointment is for the Financial Year 2026-27. The company stated there are no other material reasons for the change.

attchmntText: Gayatri Highways Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gayatri Highways Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half-year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. The company reported a net profit after tax of 10,464.42 lakhs for the quarter, driven by exceptional items totaling 10,784.19 lakhs from the sale of HKR Roadways Limited shares and redemption of preference shares. Ms. Venkata Sindhujapotha Pragada resigned as Independent Director effective 11th November 2026. M/s MOS & Associates LLP was appointed as Internal Auditor effective 12th November 2026. The statutory auditors, PPKG & Co., issued a qualified report on the financial results. The company noted an outstanding term loan default of 3,614.26 lakhs as of 30th September 2026.
